prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: It was **Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez**, a 60-year-old hospital legal adviser from Argentina. She won **Miss Buenos Aires 2024**, though she did not win the national Miss Argentina title or become Miss Universe.
